walkthroughs.h2: Why did the Provisional Government weaken?
walkthroughs.body_html: The Provisional Government continued the war to maintain Allied credit and democratic legitimacy. The Kerensky Offensive in June collapsed within days. Inflation worsened: prices tripled by autumn 1917. Land redistribution awaited the Constituent Assembly. Peasant seizures spread, soldiers deserted, and dual power left government unable to enforce decisions.

Lenin returned to Petrograd via a sealed German train on 3 April 1917. His April Theses rejected cooperation with the Provisional Government and demanded immediate end to the war. After July Days he fled to Finland, writing State and Revolution. The Kornilov affair in August allowed Bolsheviks to pose as saviours of Petrograd; Bolshevik majorities in Petrograd and Moscow Soviets followed by September.

General Kornilov, appointed Commander-in-Chief in July, moved troops on Petrograd in late August. Kerensky requested Soviet help; Red Guards were armed to defend the city. Kornilov's defeat discredited military counter-revolution and gave Bolsheviks legitimacy as defenders of the revolution. By October Lenin pressed the Central Committee for armed insurrection.

mcqs.q: Why did the Provisional Government fail in 1917?
options: Lenin personally led the storming of the Winter Palace.
The Provisional Government fell because Lenin was personally more charismatic than Kerensky.
It continued the unpopular war, did not redistribute land, shared 'dual power' with the Petrograd Soviet, and was discredited by the Kornilov affair before the Bolshevik takeover.
The Provisional Government fell because the Tsar returned and reclaimed his throne.

mcqs.q: What did Lenin's April Theses demand in 1917?
options: Lenin's April Theses called for an immediate alliance with the Provisional Government.
No support for the Provisional Government, all power to the Soviets, end the war, redistribute land — slogans summarised as 'Peace, Bread, Land'.
The Provisional Government fell because the Tsar returned and reclaimed his throne.
The April Theses created the Soviet Union.

mcqs.q: What happened in the Russian Revolution of 1917?
options: Lenin personally led the storming of the Winter Palace.
The Provisional Government fell because the Tsar returned and reclaimed his throne.
The Bolsheviks overthrew the Tsar in 1917.
There were two revolutions: February overthrew the Tsar and installed the Provisional Government; October saw the Bolsheviks seize power from that government.
